title: Jade
body:
Description

Jade is an uncommon, green ore found on Ferwater Island within Sandslate nodes. It is found in the caves of the desert or in large deposits in the rock walls of the canyon. It can be obtained too in it's ore form by defeating the king sand worm in the Worm Shrine.

This ore is a similar color to Lumite, besides not having the neon effect.
